line.en: the book festival at tampere-talo is open 10:00 to 17:00 on sunday, one-day ticket 14 euro. a good plan for a grey afternoon.
line.de: das buchfestival im tampere-talo ist sonntag von 10 bis 17 uhr offen, tageskarte 14 euro. ein guter plan für einen grauen nachmittag.
line.tr: tampere-talo'daki kitap festivali pazar günü 10:00 ile 17:00 arası açık, günlük bilet 14 euro. gri bir öğleden sonra için iyi bir plan.

sparks.why: Tampere Book Festival 28-29 Nov 2026 at Tampere Hall (Tampere-talo event page gives Sunday 10:00-17:00 and a EUR 14 day ticket); the Visit Tampere autumn 2026 calendar gives the same dates.
